name: Pika SDK
description: Official toolkit for building PIKA robot games without the robot: engine contract generated from the firmware, browser demo kit, AI skill, docs, Lua libraries, examples and gate tools. Pika Studio loads it through the pika.sdk.source setting. The only proof that it matches a firmware build is tools/gen_contract.py --firmware <checkout> --check.

contract.description: api.json (every Lua name, generated), constraints.json (every limit, derived value and fact, generated), semantics.json (behaviour of every call and hook, known issues, PC-vs-robot gaps; hand-written) and pages/ (reference page templates). tools/gen_contract.py renders docs/reference/ and skill/api-contract.md + skill/constraints.md from them.

kit.description: Browser robot frame (pika-frame.js): the engine's hooks, API names and limits, live lints, pika-spec.json export. Start from kit/template/.

skill.description: Knowledge pack for AI coding assistants: routing, rules, recipes and templates to design a demo, write Lua, or port a demo to Lua. Entry: skill/SKILL.md.

docs.description: Docs for people by kind: start/, guides/ (one reader + one goal), concepts/, reference/ (pipeline; generated API, manifest, telemetry, known issues), templates/ (brief, prompts, guide skeleton).

libraries.description: Standard Lua modules. Pika Studio copies them into <game>/libs/.

examples.description: Runnable game packs, each showing one part of the engine; pick_word pairs the kit template with its Lua port.

tools.description: gen_contract.py (contract and reference pages from the firmware), check_docs.py (docs vs contract, links, anchors, indexes, recipes), smoke.py (lint + run a Lua pack in real Lua 5.5 against a stub built from the contract), playtest.js (headless demo run), check_spec.py (demo hand-off gate), png2rgb565.py (PNG to .rgb565 images and frame strips). Python deps: tools/requirements.txt; Node deps: tools/package.json.
